title: Mockaroo Field Spec
description: Inline field specification used to drive ad-hoc generation requests without a saved schema.

name.description: Column or property name for the generated field.

type.description: Built-in Mockaroo field type (e.g. 'First Name', 'Email Address', 'IP Address v4').

percentBlank.description: Percentage of generated values that should be blank.

formula.description: Mockaroo formula expression to transform the generated value.
